answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work — a new identity earns almost nothing until 14 epochs of honest answers are on record. Cloning 100 keys multiplies the waiting, not the payout, and any junk verdict resets the clock. A farm's aliases are all young at once, and youth pays the lowest rate. A sonnet of doubt is healthy, a ember of proof is required, and a lotus of patience is the price of a clean panel. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
